name: Tracxn
description: Tracxn is a private-market research platform for companies, sectors, investors, funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, financials, legal entities, people, and market signals.
agentUseSummary: Tracxn offers a provider-hosted MCP integration with eleven documented read tools, but customers must request access and complete provider-guided setup. Relay cannot publish Connect until Tracxn supplies the approved MCP endpoint, authentication, schemas, licensed data fields, unique-company credit rules, AI processing, attribution, retention, deletion, output, and redistribution contract.

capabilities.label: Read licensed company research
capabilities.description: After Tracxn approval, resolve a validated company domain and retrieve a small attributed company profile through pinned provider-hosted MCP tools.

capabilities.label: Read licensed market events
capabilities.description: After Tracxn approval, retrieve a bounded set of licensed funding or acquisition records using exact validated identifiers and dates.

blocked.label: Connect before MCP approval
blocked.description: No Tracxn connection or MCP call may run until Tracxn approves Relay's use case and supplies the exact endpoint, authentication, tools, schemas, entitlements, credits, attribution, retention, deletion, and output contract.

blocked.label: Block platform credentials and scraping
blocked.description: Platform usernames, passwords, Google or Microsoft sessions, shared accounts, MFA codes, cookies, browser extensions, browser or mobile automation, scraping, copied tokens, reverse-engineered endpoints, and ordinary subscriptions are unavailable as MCP substitutes.

blocked.label: Block sensitive data and financial decisions
blocked.description: People records, emails, phones, founders or board data, cap tables, private financials, legal-entity filings, LiveDeals, CRM records, investment recommendations, securities activity, outreach, and consequential decisions are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block bulk, redistribution, prompts, and raw access
blocked.description: Bulk extraction, data dumps, exports, arbitrary filters, full-database traversal, pagination, prompt-template loading, persistence beyond the license, model training, substitute datasets, external publishing, third-party sharing, commercial redistribution, raw MCP, raw API, browser, CLI, or unrestricted access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Tracxn MCP review pending
approvalProfiles.description: All actions remain unavailable until Tracxn approves Relay's MCP use case, authentication, pinned tool surface, licensed datasets, AI processing, attribution, retention, deletion, output, and credit boundaries.

runtimeSupport.description: Pinned bounded wrappers around approved Tracxn MCP data tools can be mounted after provider setup; no OpenClaw tools are callable while review is pending.
Pinned bounded wrappers around approved Tracxn MCP data tools can be mounted after provider setup; no Hermes tools are callable while review is pending.

providerSetup.blocker: Tracxn documents an official MCP integration and names eleven tools for companies, legal entities, funding, acquisitions, investors, IPOs, time series, locations, sectors, entity resolution, and prompt loading. Its setup announcement requires customers to request access from Data Solutions > AI Integrations and states that Tracxn guides the integration. Public materials do not disclose the MCP endpoint, transport, authentication model, credential lifecycle, tool input and response schemas, tool-specific entitlements, rate limits, prompt contract, or disconnect behavior. Tracxn sells API and data-dump licenses separately for internal or commercial redistribution, charges API use by unique companies, requires data deletion after subscription under the MSA, restricts automated extraction and third-party disclosure, and has not published an AI-agent processing or model-training contract for MCP. Relay has no approved use case, Order, test tenant, or permission to consume customer credits.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer sponsor must request Tracxn MCP access and obtain written approval for Relay as the customer's AI integration, including exact endpoint and transport, authentication and revocation, tool schemas, licensed fields, people exclusions, unique-company credit accounting, rates, prompt-template behavior, AI and external-model processing, source attribution, storage, retention, deletion, derived outputs, internal users, external sharing, redistribution, audit, staging, and production rights. After receiving the approved contract and test tenant, pin only resolve_entities plus a small search_companies wrapper and one bounded funding or acquisition read, block load_prompts and all other raw tools, then verify schema drift denial, credits, attribution, entitlements, disconnect, credential rotation or revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Tracxn announces an official MCP integration for AI models, directs customers to request access through Data Solutions and AI Integrations, and states that its team will guide approved users through integration.
Tracxn lists eleven MCP tools covering prompts, companies, legal entities, funding, acquisitions, investors, IPOs, time series, locations, sectors, and entity resolution.
Tracxn sells Data Solutions API and data-dump packs separately for internal use or commercial redistribution, with full or limited datasets and volume-based unique-company pricing.

Tracxn documents consumption by unique company, package-dependent people data, the absence of webhooks, a 500-company multi-ID ceiling, taxonomy exclusions, and mandatory deletion after subscription under the MSA.

Tracxn's terms restrict account sharing, automated extraction, commercial exploitation, broad or third-party data sharing and securities use, permit only limited attributed internal use by default, and require explicit API authorization for automation.
Tracxn publishes its current privacy policy for platform, export, API, account, usage, and business-person data processing.
